description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Header' for a Next.js project. It provides a header UI with search functionality, navigation links, and user account controls (login/logout), integrating with a Supabase backend for authentication.

methods.name: Header
methods.description: React functional component rendering the header UI with search, navigation, and auth controls.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles the search form submission, updating the URL query parameter 'q' and routing to '/notes' with the search query.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Signs out the user via Supabase auth and redirects to the '/auth' page.
